title: MiniMax Code
intro: MiniMax Code (`mcode`), headless over `mcode exec --output-format stream-json`, on an Anthropic-shaped provider through a config file the folder writes into `$HI_DIR` each turn.
notes: The config names a custom provider with the gateway URL and the session token as its key, and lists the model under `models` (an unlisted model is refused).
`--continue` resumes the latest session in the workspace.
`permissionMode: "off"` runs tools without checks; the container is the boundary.
